operators.name: embedding_bag_forward
semantics: Computes nn.EmbeddingBag with mode='sum': for each bag i, output[i] = sum(weight[input[offsets[i]:offsets[i+1]]], dim=0).
The input indices are int64 CPU; they are transferred to CUDA inside the operator.
The weight tensor remains on CPU and is transferred to CUDA inside the operator.
The function returns a CUDA float32 tensor of shape [num_bags, embedding_dim].
The operator may internally allocate CUDA memory and synchronize streams.
Forward pass of nn.EmbeddingBag with mode='sum' on input indices and offsets.
Output tensor shape [2,5], dtype float32, device cuda:0.
For each bag, sum the embedding vectors of all indices in that bag.
